description_en: Queries the detailed configuration of a metric check template by template ID and returns the metric definitions included in the template
description_zh: 按模版 ID 查询指标校验模版的详细配置，返回模版包含的指标定义
name: GetDataCheckTemplate

parameters.help_en: The check template ID (logical foreign key) that uniquely identifies a check template
parameters.help_zh: 校验模板 ID（逻辑外键），唯一标识一个校验模板
parameters.name: template_id

basicMetricRules.description_en: The list of check rules for basic data type metrics. This field is required when checkType is set to 1 (metric comparison)

checkMethods.description_en: The check methods (metric calculation methods). Multiple values are separated by commas, such as SUM,AVG,MIN,MAX. The values must be within the range allowed by the templatetype
checkMethods.description_zh: 校验方式（指标计算方法），多个值以英文逗号分隔，如 SUM,AVG,MIN,MAX，须在模板类型允许的范围内

dataTypeGroup.description_en: The data type group that identifies the data type category to which the check rule applies. The value is an integer from 0 to 7. For the meaning of each value, refer to the valid values

diffTolerateType.description_en: The difference tolerance rate type. Valid values: 0: unified. 1: custom. Default value: 0
diffTolerateType.description_zh: 差异容忍率类型：0-统一，1-自定义（默认 0）

additionalProperties.description_en: The difference tolerance rate value. For the unified type, one value is used, such as {"SAME": 0}. For the custom type, values are set separately by the configured tolerance type, such as {"SUM": 0.01, "AVG": 0.001}

columnEqualCmpType.description_en: The equality comparison type for row-level column-by-column comparison. Valid values: 0: all field types. 1: primitive basic data types. 2: composite data types. 3: custom

columnIsIgnoreNull.description_en: Specifies whether to ignore differences between null values and empty strings during row-by-row and column-by-column comparison. Valid values: 0: No. 1: Yes

columnIsIgnoreZero.description_en: Specifies whether to ignore differences between null values and 0 values during row-by-row and column-by-column comparison. Valid values: 0: No. 1: Yes

columnSamplesType.description_en: The sampling method during row-by-row and column-by-column comparison. Valid values: 0: by row. 1: by percentage
columnSamplesType.description_zh: 逐行逐列比对时的抽样方式：0-按行，1-按百分比

columnSamplesValue.description_en: The sampling value during row-by-row and column-by-column comparison. The meaning depends on the sampling method. When sampling by row, this value represents the number of rows. When sampling by percentage, this value represents the percentage

ruleId.description_en: The rule ID that uniquely identifies a check rule
ruleId.description_zh: 规则 ID，唯一标识一条校验规则

templateId.description_en: The check template ID (logical foreign key) that uniquely identifies a check template
templateId.description_zh: 校验模板 ID（逻辑外键），唯一标识一个校验模板

templateName.description_en: The name of the check template

weakContentRule.description_en: The weak content check rule. This parameter has a value and is required when checkType is set to 2 (weak content comparison). For the field structure, see the child field descriptions
weakContentRule.description_zh: 弱内容校验规则，checkType=2（弱内容对比）时有值且必填，字段结构参见下级子字段说明

filterColumnTypes.description_en: The filter column types, separated by vertical bars (|)
filterColumnTypes.description_zh: 过滤字段类型 用|进行分割

items.description_en: The filter column type (column type that participates in the check). Multiple values are separated by vertical bars (|)
items.description_zh: 过滤字段类型（参与校验的列类型），多个以竖线 | 分隔

filterColumnTypes.title_en: 过滤字段类型 用|进行分割
filterColumnTypes.title_zh: 过滤字段类型 用|进行分割

ruleId.description_en: The rule ID that uniquely identifies a check rule
ruleId.description_zh: 规则 ID，唯一标识一条校验规则

weakContentAlgorithm.description_en: The weak content algorithm name. Valid values: md5 and crc32

errCode.description_en: The error code. An empty string is returned if the call is successful
errCode.description_zh: 错误码，调用成功时为空字符串

errMessage.description_en: The error message. An empty string is returned if the call is successful
errMessage.description_zh: 错误信息，调用成功时为空字符串

requestId.description_en: The request ID, which is used to locate and troubleshoot issues
requestId.description_zh: 请求 ID，用于定位和排查本次调用问题

success.description_en: Indicates whether the call is successful. Valid values: true: The call is successful. false: The call failed. If the call failed, check errCode and errMessage for details
success.description_zh: 调用是否成功：true 表示成功，false 表示失败，失败时结合 errCode 与 errMessage 排查
